mapper.sql: id, order_no, request_id, user_id, status, total_amount, has_physical, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, tracking_no, created_at, paid_at, packed_at, shipped_at, completed_at, cancelled_at, refunded_at, refund_amount
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, request_id, user_id, status, total_amount, has_physical, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{hasPhysical}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = NOW(3) WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = NOW(3) WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW(3) WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND (status = 'SHIPPED' OR (status = 'PAID' AND has_physical = 0))
UPDATE orders SET status = 'PACKING', packed_at = NOW(3) WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'PAID' AND has_physical = 1
UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'REFUND_REQUESTED' WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PAID', 'PACKING') AND has_physical = 1
UPDATE orders SET status = 'REFUNDED', refunded_at = NOW(3), refund_amount = total_amount WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'REFUND_REQUESTED'

UPDATE orders SET status = 'RETURN_REQUESTED' WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} AND has_physical = 1 AND (status = 'SHIPPED' OR (status = 'COMPLETED' AND completed_at >= NOW(3) - INTERVAL 7 DAY))
UPDATE orders SET status = 'RETURNING' WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'RETURN_REQUESTED'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'RETURN_SHIPPED' WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'RETURNING'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'REFUNDED', refunded_at = NOW(3), refund_amount = total_amount WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'RETURN_SHIPPED'
